question: ICICI Bank has partnered with which of the following agencies in October 2024 to provide instant credit on UPI for pre-approved customers, offering up to ₹2 lakh credit with a 45-day repayment period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phone Pe**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In October 2024, **ICICI Bank partnered with PhonePe **to offer instant credit on UPI for pre-approved customers.
 
• The credit line is **available for up to ₹2 lakh** with a repayment period of 45 days
 
• This facility can be used for purchasing **high-ticket items like electronics, travel, and hotel bookings**
 
• It can a**lso be used for bill payments**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ICICI**

 
 
• ICICI Bank stands for Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India__.
 
• ICICI was formed in 1955.
 
• The objective was to create a development financial institution for providing medium-term and long-term project financing to Indian businesses.
 
• Headquarters: Mumbai.
 
 
 
• **PhonePe**
 
 
• **​**PhonePe is an **Indian digital payment**s and financial services company **headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**
 
• It was** founded in December 2015 by Sameer Nigam, **Rahul Chari and Burzin Engineer
